The '''Elliirad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the world [[Elliirad]].<ref name="XWvTF" />

==History==
The system was the location of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[XQ6 Platform]] [[Elliirad Platform]]. It was [[Battle of Elliirad|attacked]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
